profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer
profile.summary: 10+ years of experience in client-side web development, specializing in web analytics and styling. Broad knowledge of advanced HTML/CSS/JS as well as reactive frameworks like Vue JS. Works well with designers and project managers, has a passion for the user's needs and accessibility. Proficient with Adobe Customer Journey, Adobe Analytics, Adobe Experience Management, Adobe Experience Platform and Data Collection, AJO, RTCDP, Adobe Target, tag managers like GTM and Tealium, AB testing and personalization.

positions.title: Marketing Analytics Developer
positions.description:
Implementing tags to track user behavior and developing solutions for Adobe Analytics, Google, and Mixpanel to improve analytics tracking in compliance with GDPR and CCPA policy.
Writing automation scripts with Puppeteer to facilitate QA work and reduce the risk of releasing bugs into production.
Writing data documentation and design documents to explain how and why the code works that way.
Updating tickets assigned within a Scrum and Agile development environment to properly document work accomplished in biweekly sprints.

positions.title: Sr. Marketing Tech Specialist
positions.description:
Adobe Analytics and Google Analytics implementation.
Tealium tag management development.
AB testing and customer segment analysis and reporting.

positions.title: Targeted Marketing Specialist
positions.locationName: 17560 Rowland St, City of Industry, CA 91745
positions.description:
Analyze customer segments by their behaviors and purchasing trends using A/B testing to understand and meet their needs.
Revamp our analytics implementation to produce traffic reports that satisfy our business team needs.

positions.title: Web Content Specialist
positions.description:
Troubleshoot customer issues that related to their web experience.
Programmed additional functionality to web mock up templates.
Managed third-party tags, including analytics, affiliates, and web tools.
